name: I'm Now the School Delinquent's Lover, but I Want Out!!
source:
Your final high school year; a time for making memories, friends, living life to the fullest! ...Unfortunately for Akahana Haruto, it seems like this year, too, he'll remain the same old invisible classmate, going about his day in silence and solidute. But when the leader of the delinquent group in school makes a surprise confession, Haruto's life goes from quiet to chaotic in five seconds flat!!

Will he be able to escape the clutches of the terrifying delinquent? Or is chaos just the thing to spice up his quiet school life?

[From [url=https://konpeitocat.itch.io/im-now-the-school-delinquents-lover-but-i-want-out]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你高中最后一年；一个创造回忆、结交朋友、充实生活的时刻！…对于赤花晴人来说不幸的是，今年他似乎也将仍然是那个看不见的老同学，默默地、坚定地度过他的一天。然而，当学校不良集团的头目出人意料地表白时，Haruto的生活在短短五秒内从平静变得混乱！！

他能否逃脱可怕罪犯的魔爪？或者混乱只是为了给他安静的学校生活增添趣味？

[来自[url=https://konpeitocat.itch.io/im-now-the-school-delinquents-lover-but-i-want-out]Itch.io[/url]]
